newsitem.title: USA: NYCE cotton closes down, focus on Dec/March spread.
newsitem.headline: NYCE cotton closes down, focus on Dec/March spread.

text.p: NYCE cotton futures ended lower in brisk volume focused on the December/March switch, floor sources said.
The switch closed at 1.92 today compared to 2.11 Thursday.
"The spreads were the major feature and why the volume is so high," a trader said.
Today's volume was estimated at 19,000 lots.

Dealers had expected December to fall below the day's low of 71.25 and rack up additional losses, but the contract held and closed at 71.50, down 0.58. "That portends a bullish move next week," one dealer said.
The back months ened 0.53 to 0.13 weaker.
Support in December remained at 70.00, where the contract found a base earlier in the week. Resistance remained at 74.00, where producer selling is expected to cap any potential rally, analysts said.
